summary: Frontend-only regression test for responsiveness fix (bad global find-and-replace that injected testID="..." inside CSS attribute selectors in /app/frontend/app/+html.tsx). All 8 review items PASS. Source has 0 occurrences of ' testID=' in +html.tsx. Rendered pages contain 0 malformed CSS selectors matching pattern [data-testid="..." testID=. querySelector('[data-testid="app-shell"]') parses without SyntaxError. Mobile 390x844, mobile 320x700, tablet 768x1024, and desktop 1920x800 all render with document.documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth (zero horizontal overflow) on both the public welcome page and authenticated /dashboard, /job-search, /settings. Admin login (admin@realaicoach.app / NewAdminPass2026!) succeeds and lands at '/' without regressions from the useLoginControllerLegacy.ts querySelector fix; user can focus, type in, and submit email/password fields. Mobile layout at 320px exposes a mobile-nav element. Desktop sidebar layout renders at 1920px. No pageerrors, no SyntaxErrors – only expected 401 responses from unauthenticated API pings pre-login.
critical_code_review_comments: The +html.tsx responsive CSS injection is now clean (0 malformed selectors), but consider adding a lint/CI check that rejects any occurrence of ' testID=' inside <style>...</style> attribute selectors in +html.tsx to prevent this class of regression from recurring via careless find-and-replace.

Similarly, add a runtime dev-mode guard that wraps document.querySelector calls in try/catch (or use a helper) so a malformed selector string does not throw a SyntaxError that unmounts the calling flow (login/onboarding).
test_credentials: Admin admin@realaicoach.app / NewAdminPass2026! validated. Login selectors: [data-testid=login-email-input], [data-testid=login-password-input], [data-testid=login-submit-button].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend was tested via http://localhost:3000 (static export served by serve-production.js). Public preview URL https://admin-policy-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/ also returns 200. Responsive CSS fix is verified across 320/390/768/1920 viewports. Login flow works end-to-end. If future work touches +html.tsx <style> blocks, re-run the malformed selector count check: document.querySelectorAll('style').map(s=>s.textContent).join().match(/\[data-testid="[^\]]+ testID=/g) should be null.
rca of the issue: N/A – bug already resolved by main agent. Verification only. Root cause (as reported): a global find-and-replace injected ' testID="..."' into 26 CSS attribute selectors inside /app/frontend/app/+html.tsx and 3 JS querySelector strings, invalidating entire CSS rule lists (browsers drop the entire selector list when one selector is invalid) and throwing SyntaxError at runtime. Main agent stripped the offending fragments, rebuilt static export, restarted expo_manual. All confirmed clean by this iteration.
